Name: Aimon's Fancy Cellar (aka Redesigned Cellar Layout)
Author: Aimon111
Description:
[font=Georgia][b][color=#fce5cd]Makes your cellar maps look new and fresh towards more realistic layout. Also adds some new custom room accessible through cellar![/color][/b]

[size=2]Made this mod as an addition to my [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14411]Redesigned Farmhouse mod[/url].[/size]


[u][color=#00ff00]I plan on adding some things in the future, such as:[/color][/u]
[size=2][spoiler]
[/size][/font][list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=2]Custom warps in that small cave room (those warps will teleport player to such places like Clint's and Willy's shop, Desert cave entrance and other useful places that you visit pretty often)[/size][/font]
[/list][list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=2]Some small events (to unlock this small warp room in the future you'll need to acquire  some special item. Since having room with so many useful warps is kinda endgame content in my opinion. But ofc it will be highly configurable and you could enable or disable those warps).[/size][/font]
[/list][list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=2]More recolor option (for now it's only for Rustic Country Town Interior (dark) ﻿ [/spoiler][/size][/font]
[/list][font=Georgia][size=3]
[/size][/font][font=Georgia][u][b][color=#ff7700]How to install:[/color]
[/b][/u]
[/font][list=1]
[*][font=Georgia][size=2]Download all the required mods[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=2]Put "Redesigned Cellar Layout" folder from archive to your mods folder[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=2]Done! [/size][/font]
[/list][font=Georgia][size=2]NOTE: ﻿For stardew 1.5.6 you'll also need Extra Map Layers and Custom Decoration Areas mods
[/size][/font][font=Georgia][u][b][color=#ff7700]Compability:
[/color][/b][/u]
[/font][list]
[*][font=Georgia][color=#b6d7a8][size=2]Compatible with other farmhosue mods (Seasonal Garden Farmhouse V2 and others)[/size][/color][/font]
[*][color=#fff2cc][font=Georgia][size=2]Probably there's some issues with multiplayer, I didn't test it[/size][/font][/color]
[*][font=Georgia][color=#f4cccc][size=2]Not compatible with android (for now)[/size][/color][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][color=#f4cccc][size=2]Not compatible with other Cellar mods (for obivious reasons)[/size][/color][/font]
[/list][font=Georgia]
[u][b][color=#ff7700]There's also some bugs present in the mod (maybe I'll succeed on fixing them in the future, dunno):
[/color][/b][/u]
[size=2][s]1. If you use my Redesigned Farmhouse mod - at first save load your cellar entrance will be messed up. I'm sorry for this inconvenience  and will try to fix it in the future [/s]- Fixed by adding compatibility patch in my Redesigned Farmhouse mod
2. When using Vanilla Farmhouse the floor tiles at cellar entrance will be bugged (see the[url=http://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/14521/14521-1669142590-895092676.png] screenshot[/url]﻿)
To fix it:
[/size][/font][list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=2] ﻿Go to Redesigned Cellar config menu,[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=2] ﻿Disable the mod,[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=2] ﻿Exit the config menu, wait 10 seconds (just stand still a bit),[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=2] ﻿Go to config again and enable the mod.[/size][/font]
[/list][font=Georgia][size=2]3. Some wall tiles will overlap player and placed items (see the [url=http://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/14521/14521-1668798667-1490644748.png]screenshot[/url]) [/size]
[/font][size=2][size=2][size=2][size=2][size=2][size=2][size=3][center][/center][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size][/size]
